answer: Anyone running 83 aliases therefore needs 75 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are recorded in relic, expire in karst, and ledge lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 9 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3560 identities would post 2310 proofs and burn roughly 32 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
